ground_truth_use.consequence: The 2.5k tier is now a development set and cannot support a promoted performance claim for v3.

revisit_opportunity_audit.definition: camera-1 GT centres, frame gap at least 64, complete three-frame forward or reverse path, interpolation gap at most 0.1 seconds
revisit_opportunity_audit.finding: A non-empty learned-loop requirement is not meaningful at 1k under the tight 0.5 m opportunity definition; 2.5k is the first tier with scorable opportunities.

published_ann_post_hoc_audit.finding: Top-32 retrieval covers nearly every GT-opportunity frame, but the v2 descriptor ratio rejects all five path-supported proximity pairs while retaining the known false sequence.

v3_development_policy.name: rank-path-cycle-v3
v3_development_policy.pre_match: mutual rank below two, complete forward or reverse three-frame path, degree at most two; descriptor distance ratio is diagnostic only

rotation_cycle.diagnosis: The 937-940 versus 1001-1004 path near GT proximity opportunities has 17-28 degree within-pair sensor rotation dispersion. Frozen SIFT matching and essential geometry do not provide consistent multi-sensor rotations for these additions.

decision.reason: The mandatory pose-free geometry gate admits nothing. Relaxing its 3 degree threshold would also admit isolated evidence from the known false loop and would be GT-driven tuning.
decision.next: Keep the ANN speedup. Replace the local matcher/two-view evidence for the bounded shortlist, then require the same frozen rotation-cycle gate before mapping on an unobserved holdout interval.
